title: Isekai Executioner: The Serial Killer in Another World
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A serial killer who wants to stop but cannot finally receives the death sentence he wished for, only to be reincarnated in another world. A goddess, whose twelve earlier reincarnated champions became worse than the evil they fought, tasks him with killing them, using his murderous urges for a larger purpose (emaqi blurb via AniList; MU; MyAnimeList synopsis). AniList and MU list a gender swap on reincarnation.
life_message: Even a person defined by violence may be turned toward a purpose, though the story questions what redemption can mean for a killer.

folkways.japan: It reworks the Japanese isekai convention of the 'cheat-power' hero by making those heroes the villains, noted as genre context.
